observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 are identical images of a tall, dark brown wooden wardrobe with a single visible door on the left and an open shelving unit on the right.
The wardrobe has a wood-grain finish, likely laminate or veneer, not solid wood.
The left door has a vertical silver handle.
The right side has four open shelves of varying heights.
The item appears to be in used condition with minor scuffs and marks visible on the door and shelves.
No brand or model markings are visible on the item in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'two doors wooden wardrobe', but only one door is visible in the photos.
The seller states 'Making is wood' — this cannot be verified from the photos alone; it may be particle board with wood veneer or laminate.

claims.evidence: Only one door is visible in the photos. The second door may be on the other side or missing. No photo shows the back or full front view.

The wood grain finish suggests laminate or veneer, but the core material cannot be determined from photos. A close-up of the edge or back would be needed to verify if it is solid wood or particle board.
The item shows minor wear and no major damage, consistent with 'neatly used' condition.

risks.risk: The wardrobe may have only one door, not two as claimed.
risks.proof: A photo showing the full front view or the back of the wardrobe to confirm the presence of a second door.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a one-door wardrobe, which is significantly less valuable.

risks.risk: The material is not solid wood, but particle board or MDF with laminate, which affects durability and value.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the edge or back of the wardrobe to show the core material.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a laminate or veneer unit, not solid wood.

risks.risk: Hidden damage or structural issues not visible in the photos, such as loose shelves or damaged hinges.
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the interior from multiple angles, including the back and sides, and the door opening and closing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at a discount for potential hidden defects.

proof_requests: Photo of the full front view or back of the wardrobe to confirm the number of doors.
Close-up photo of the edge or back to verify the material (solid wood vs. laminate/particle board).
Video or photo showing the door opening and closing, and the interior from multiple angles.
response.reason: The seller claims a two-door wardrobe, but only one door is visible. The material is unverifiable from the photos. Without proof of the second door and material, the item cannot be accurately priced. The current photos do not support a confident price assessment.
